These frameworks can enable data scientists to process and analyze large datasets in parallel, which can reduce processing times.  Ethical consideration in data science Data science involves collecting, processing, and analyzing data which often includes personal and sensitive information. Ethical concerns include potential privacy violations, bias perpetuation, and negative societal impacts. Machine learning models can amplify existing biases present in training data, leading to discriminatory or unfair outcomes.
